name: SingleStatCard
description: Hero stat tile rendering one big number with a label and optional delta indicator
descriptionFull:
Hero stat tile rendering one big number with a label and optional delta indicator.

Displays a single statistic with optional animations and variants

props.name: color
props.description: Color for the value on every variant, plus the border on `tertiary` and the flash animations

props.name: variant
props.description: Card variant. `compact` is a centred name-over-value tile in muted text, for dense grids of secondary metrics

props.name: caption
props.description: Short text beside the name, e.g. the unit basis ("per PH/s/day")

props.name: tag
props.description: Badge after the value, e.g. "estimated" or a change

props.name: detail
props.description: Line below the value, e.g. how the figure was reached

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class for the root element
